ghost._steal_note: Soul steal heals the HP the hit took, at most steal_max_hp (user, November 19; was a quarter of it).
ghost._speed_note: Per SotN tick (60 a second). SotN itself: approach distance/8, cling distance/2, no cap; the user found that too fast.
ghost._note: Attack every 120 120 100 100 90 90 75 75 60 SotN ticks by cards owned (1-9), SotN's table; soul steal from that table's index 7 (8+ cards). Power uses the game's spell rule P + (P/64 + 0.25) * INT.

sword_brothers._note: SotN's spell 7 (DRA.BIN spell table +0x8410): 30 MP, attack 20. Command (user's smoother version of SotN's): down, down-forward, forward, up-forward, up, down, then X or Y, each within 30 frames. Only with the Sword Card equipped. Power goes from power_l1 at 1 card to power_max at 9, plus the INT rule; each enemy is hit once as the wheel of 64 blades (radius_px wide) passes it.

faerie._note: Cooldowns go from the first value at 1 card to the second at 9 cards. Statuses: 0 poison, 1 curse, 2 stone, cured with the native 8244DCA0 (the Remedy path). The heal is Charlotte's Heal (learningset kind 8, index 2) cast through the skill factory at level = cards - 1, so its power is Heal's (30 at level 1 to 50, plus the INT rule). Lines: healing, potion, regeneration, oh_no (SotN 0x885, 0x886, 0x887, 0x891).

drops._note: Native table edits (tools/familiar_drops.py). Enemy drops go in a free item slot of the enemy's EnemyParam row (rate out of 1000, before luck); the Monster Compendium lists them. Chest entries are explicit weighted items in the stage set file, drawn out of max(total weight, 10000) before luck (823AA6D8), so 300 is about 3% a chest. The cards' soul rows allow Alucard only, so nobody else receives them. Enemies are matched by internal resource name; the English name is the one at EnemyParam +0x28.
drops._rate_note: Per-enemy 'rate' overrides it: Bat and Ghost 10 (user, November 19: both are easy to farm). A card's 'rarity' is its soul row +0x3A, the menu's rarity stars (Peeping Eye 5, Death 4); the drop roll (82243088) does not use it.
